description.narrative: Equitable access to quality secondary education enhanced

Percentage of students enrolled in science subjects in grade 11 increased to 6.0% (girls) and 14.0% (boys) (2015 baseline: girls, 2.1%; boys, 5.0%) Achievement: 12.7 Progress/Status: Achieved. Percentage of students enrolled in science subjects in grade 11 has increased to 12.7% (girls) and 17.3% (boys). Data Source: EMIS/MOE report
Cohort survival rate for grades 1-10 increased to 50.0% (2015 baseline: 37.9%) Achievement: 58.5 Progress/Status: Achieved. Data Source: EMIS/MOE report

GER in secondary education (grades 9−12) increased to 66.7 (girls: 66.6; boys: 66.8) (2015 baseline: 56.7 [girls: 56.6; boys: 56.8]) Achievement: 75.7 Progress/Status: Achieved. Based on the progress reported by the MOEST in the Joint Review Mission in November 2021, the GER in secondary education (grades 9-12) has reached 75.7 (76.8 for girls and 74.4 for boys), thus significantly surpassing the targets. Data Source: EMIS/MOE report

Data Source: OAG audit reports
